text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Members of parliament of the main opposition Malawi Congress Party, attending parliament in defiance of their party's boycott, caused a temporary stalemate in the National Assembly on Wednesday when they attempted to block the Taxation Bill. They demanded that the bill be tabled after the budget has been debated and adopted.
- The government said it would adopt a phased approach to implement salaries for civil servants recommended by a report on which the Civil Servants Trade Union has based its wage talks.

- The opposition Malawi Congress Party has appealed against the decision by the High Court which allowed the Electoral Commission to set April 17 as the date for by-elections Blantyre's Ndirande area.
